name: Garumbatitan
isnote: A somphospondylan sauropod (Mocho et al. 2024); the clade Laurasiformes it was first linked with is problematic and has been recovered in several places within Macronaria.
sum: Garumbatitan is a somphospondylan sauropod from the Early Cretaceous Arcillas de Morella Formation of Spain.
wsnote: No length estimate was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: The remains of the largest individual, with articulated cervical and dorsal vertebrae, ribs, caudal vertebrae, both femora, tibiae and fibulae and most of the right foot; the number was not read.
material: At least four individuals found at Morella; a smaller individual is the paratype.
biology: No biological data were read in the sources consulted.
author: Mocho et al. 2024

sources.text: P. Mocho, F. Escaso, and J. M. Gasulla, A. Galobart, B. Poza, A. Santos-Cubedo, J. L. Sanz, F. Ortega. 2024. New sauropod dinosaur from the Lower Cretaceous of Morella (Spain) provides new insights on the evolutionary history of Iberian somphospondylan titanosauriforms. Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 201(1):214-268
